It's caring of you to notice these changes in your friend—you're not being paranoid. Forgetting things like the date, or basic routines like feeding pets, especially when it's a clear shift from how he used to be, is worth paying attention to. Sudden or noticeable memory changes can have many causes, some very treatable, so it's a good idea for him to get checked out by a doctor.

If you can, gently encourage him to see his primary care physician, who can evaluate what's going on. If you're close with his family, you might mention what you've observed so someone can help him follow up. And if he ever seems confused in a way that puts his safety at risk right now—like wandering, forgetting to eat for days, or seeming very disoriented—don't hesitate to reach out to someone who can check on him promptly. Trusting your instincts here is a good thing.
